team.grilling.value: solo (one person answers the interview live in the session)

loop.store.value: intent and design: summary + approval on the GitHub epic, full files committed in docs/work/<date>-<slug>/ (intent.md, spec.md, design/*.md); tickets as GitHub sub-issues

loop.gates.value: human after intent, design and review (approver: any team member except the driver); the review PR approval is the deploy gate: merge to main triggers deploys of everything; ship is automated CD after merge; outside approvals are post-merge and out of scope

loop.autonomy.value: plan mode for intent/design/plan; acceptEdits for build; AFK allowed for all ready-for-agent tickets with executable acceptance criteria, through build-validate and review up to (not including) merge to main; AFK may touch any path in the repo, including infra/ and workflows, because nothing deploys before merge; only actions that bypass the PR gate are blocked (push to main, force push, terraform apply, reading secrets); append-only rules for applied migrations and persisted events still hold; limits 120 turns, 3 failed validations, $25; result = PR, whose human approval is the deploy gate

quality.strictness.value: standard: diff size warns at 400 lines / 30 files, max_nits 5, up to 5 lenses per point, max_review_rounds 3, registry check on

quality.pr.value: filed at start of review; tiers: critical (infra/**, .github/workflows/**, backend/**/serialization/**, backend/src/main/resources/db/**, api/openapi.yaml, backend/Dockerfile, auth) 2 approvals not the driver + security/sre/data-integrity/backward-compat lenses + terraform plan and oasdiff evidence; standard (default) 1 approval + review lenses; low (docs/**, *.md except docs/sdlc/** and AGENTS.md) 1 approval, no AI. PR approval is the deploy gate.

quality.venues.value: intent and design on the GitHub epic + committed files; plan and validate local; code and improve on the PR; no PR bot

quality.surface.value: intent silent; design on the epic; review on the PR

quality.evals.value: harness suite local, threshold 1.0, max cost $10; no product suites (no AI features)

repo.greenfield.value: Web app (TypeScript + React + Vite, pnpm) in frontend/ and API service (Scala + Apache Pekko, sbt) in backend/; monorepo with root justfile; Postgres via Pekko Persistence (pekko-persistence-jdbc, event-sourced); CI: GitHub Actions (user dropped GitLab CI to stay on GitHub); deploy target undecided

repo.facts.value: Corrected: forge and CI are GitHub (PRs + Actions), default branch main; intended commands confirmed as proposed with root justfile wrapper

repo.outside.value: Security sign-off, design/architecture review, demo before release, change advisory board (CAB); all outside the repo; no outside evals

repo.folders.value: Confirmed all proposed folders; added backend/core/ (domain core module, sbt subproject) as notable: every behaviour change needs data-driven (table-driven) tests

repo.deliverables.value: adr -> infra (Terraform on AWS for the API's infrastructure) -> ci-cd -> api-image (backend container image, built in CI, pushed to a registry); adr -> db-schema; api-contract (OpenAPI YAML, contract-first) -> api -> web; docs: user-guide, tech-ops-manual, business-ops-manual; stakeholder-docs last

team.roles.value: Everyone can do everything: every team member may hold any role (product owner, tech lead, designer, platform owner, code owner, security reviewer, release manager). A gate is approved by any team member other than the work item's author/driver; the authoring agent never approves.

team.tracker.value: GitHub Issues (gh CLI against origin); default labels needs-triage, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human

loop.design.value: requirements always; solution, api, data, infra, ux, docs per deliverable; plus STRIDE threat model in solution/infra when a change crosses a trust boundary

quality.lenses.value: as shown: intent naive-reader/end-user/pre-mortem; requirements qa-test-designer/naive-reader/intent-conformance; solution skeptical-architect/security/design-critic; api api-consumer/backward-compat; data data-integrity/migration-compat; infra sre/security/finops; ux target-user/accessibility; docs new-user/structure-style/domain-expert; review correctness/spec-conformance/test-quality/silent-failure + critical extras

quality.bitten.value: tests weakened or skipped; premature done; scope creep / huge diffs; nit floods from AI review

conv.skills.value: mattpocock family as shown; cross-cutting typescript-lsp, Metals MCP, context7, playwright, GitHub MCP, HashiCorp Terraform MCP, security-guidance

wiring.enforcement.value: as shown: lefthook; Claude hooks (protect paths, format, Stop typecheck + changed tests, post-compaction status); pr-checks.sh in /charmander-review; branch protection on main; docs locations docs/work, docs/decisions, GLOSSARY.md, docs/sdlc/research, docs/ops/{tech,business}

wiring.approve.value: write all; run Claude Code installs; generate human-setup.sh with wizard
